blocks.x: Cyber & Zero-Trust for Reinsurance & Commercial Lines — zero-trust by architecture, not by slide — identity, detection, resilience and ai security in one program applied to the reinsurance & commercial lines operating unit of Insurance & Risk.

Reinsurance and specialty commercial books trade in complexity: treaty structures, cat exposure, bordereaux reconciliation and capital optimization. The data flows between cedants, reinsurers and brokers are still largely spreadsheets — which is why settlement cycles and model confidence suffer.

items: Sensitive exposure data exchanged by email/portal; confidentiality depends on culture.
Ceded premium/loss bordereaux arrive in formats and qualities; reconciliation consumes analysts and hides data quality issues.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Identity & Access Modernization, Cloud Security & Posture Management, Compliance, Audit & Digital Trust from the Cybersecurity & Zero-Trust tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Bordereaux intake/reconciliation, Treaty settlement, Retro/capacity optimization) on Achala Sentinel and Achala Compass. Governance inherits the sector frame — Solvency II / RBC among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Assume breach, plan recovery — resilience engineered, rehearsed and measured.
Evidence once, audit anywhere — compliance automation across SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, DORA and privacy.
Never trust, always verify — zero-trust as an executable architecture, not a slide.
secured data exchange with counterparties under policy (confidentiality engineered)
